download_qm9_dataset: download the QM9 gdb9 dataset from deepchem S3 and extract the tar.gz archive
read_csv_properties: create a function that reads gdb9.sdf.csv and returns a dictionary mapping molecule indices to property values
split_train_valid_test: run the train validation test split of QM9 molecules using RDKit SDMolSupplier and split index JSON files
preprocess_molecules_to_graphs: preprocess raw molecule data by converting SMILES strings to graph representations with node features and edges
get_validation_indices: load validation split indices from valid_idx_qm9.json and return a list of integer file indices
